verses.original: וְאֵ֛לֶּה אֲשֶׁר־ נָחֲל֥וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּאֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִֽחֲל֜וּ אוֹתָ֗ם אֶלְעָזָ֤ר הַכֹּהֵן֙ וִיהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ בִּן־ נ֔וּן וְרָאשֵׁ֛י אֲב֥וֹת הַמַּטּ֖וֹת לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh ’ă·šer- nā·ḥă·lū ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl bə·’e·reṣ kə·nā·‘an ’ă·šer ni·ḥă·lū ’ō·w·ṯām ’el·‘ā·zār hak·kō·hên wî·hō·wō·šu·a‘ bin- nūn wə·rā·šê ’ă·ḇō·wṯ ham·maṭ·ṭō·wṯ liḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Now these are the portions that the Israelites . . . inherited in the land of Canaan as distributed - by Eleazar the priest Joshua son of Nun and the heads of the families of the tribes of Israel
verses.literalPt: ISTO, pois, é o que os filhos de Israel tiveram em herança, na terra de Canaã, o que Eleazar, o sacerdote, e Josué, filho de Num, e os cabeças dos pais das tribos dos filhos de Israel lhes fizeram repartir,

verses.original: בְּגוֹרַ֖ל נַחֲלָתָ֑ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ בְּיַד־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה לְתִשְׁעַ֥ת הַמַּטּ֖וֹת וַחֲצִ֥י הַמַּטֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ḡō·w·ral na·ḥă·lā·ṯām ka·’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh bə·yaḏ- mō·šeh lə·ṯiš·‘aṯ ham·maṭ·ṭō·wṯ wa·ḥă·ṣî ham·maṭ·ṭeh
verses.literal: Their inheritance was assigned by lot for the nine and a half . . . tribes as the LORD had commanded through Moses
verses.literalPt: Por sorte da sua herança, como o SENHOR ordenara, pelo ministério de Moisés, acerca das nove tribos e da meia tribo.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ נָתַ֨ן מֹשֶׁ֜ה נַחֲלַ֨ת שְׁנֵ֤י הַמַּטּוֹת֙ וַחֲצִ֣י הַמַּטֶּ֔ה מֵעֵ֖בֶר לַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן וְלַ֨לְוִיִּ֔ם לֹֽא־ נָתַ֥ן נַחֲלָ֖ה בְּתוֹכָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî- nā·ṯan mō·šeh na·ḥă·laṯ šə·nê ham·maṭ·ṭō·wṯ wa·ḥă·ṣî ham·maṭ·ṭeh mê·‘ê·ḇer lay·yar·dên wə·lal·wî·yim lō- nā·ṯan na·ḥă·lāh bə·ṯō·w·ḵām
verses.literal: For Moses had given the inheritance east of the Jordan to the other two and a half . . . tribes But he granted no inheritance among them to the Levites
verses.literalPt: Porquanto às duas tribos e à meia tribo já dera Moisés herança além do Jordão; mas aos levitas não tinha dado herança entre eles.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ הָי֧וּ בְנֵֽי־ יוֹסֵ֛ף שְׁנֵ֥י מַטּ֖וֹת מְנַשֶּׁ֣ה וְאֶפְרָ֑יִם וְלֹֽא־ נָתְנוּ֩ חֵ֨לֶק לַלְוִיִּ֜ם בָּאָ֗רֶץ כִּ֤י אִם־ עָרִים֙ לָשֶׁ֔בֶת וּמִ֨גְרְשֵׁיהֶ֔ם לְמִקְנֵיהֶ֖ם וּלְקִנְיָנָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî- hā·yū ḇə·nê- yō·w·sêp̄ šə·nê maṭ·ṭō·wṯ mə·naš·šeh wə·’ep̄·rā·yim wə·lō- nā·ṯə·nū ḥê·leq lal·wî·yim bā·’ā·reṣ kî ’im- ‘ā·rîm lā·še·ḇeṯ ū·miḡ·rə·šê·hem lə·miq·nê·hem ū·lə·qin·yā·nām
verses.literal: The descendants of Joseph became two tribes Manasseh and Ephraim And no portion of the land . . . was given to the Levites except for cities in which to live along with pasturelands for their flocks and herds
verses.literalPt: Porque os filhos de José eram duas tribos, Manassés e Efraim, e aos levitas não se deu herança na terra, senão cidades em que habitassem, e os seus arrabaldes para seu gado e para seus bens.

verses.original: כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה כֵּ֥ן עָשׂ֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַֽיַּחְלְק֖וּ אֶת־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃פ
verses.transliteration: ka·’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh ’eṯ- mō·šeh kên ‘ā·śū bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl way·yaḥ·lə·qū ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: So the Israelites . . . did as the LORD had commanded Moses and they divided the land
verses.literalPt: Como o SENHOR ordenara a Moisés, assim fizeram os filhos de Israel, e repartiram a terra.

verses.original: וַיִּגְּשׁ֨וּ בְנֵֽי־ יְהוּדָ֤ה אֶל־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֙עַ֙ בַּגִּלְגָּ֔ל וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֔יו כָּלֵ֥ב בֶּן־ יְפֻנֶּ֖ה הַקְּנִזִּ֑י אַתָּ֣ה יָדַ֡עְתָּ אֶֽת־ הַדָּבָר֩ אֲשֶׁר־ דִּבֶּ֨ר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֣ה אִישׁ־ הָאֱלֹהִ֗ים עַ֧ל אֹדוֹתַ֛י וְעַ֥ל אֹדוֹתֶ֖יךָ בְּקָדֵ֥שׁ בַּרְנֵֽעַ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yig·gə·šū ḇə·nê- yə·hū·ḏāh ’el- yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ bag·gil·gāl way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw kā·lêḇ ben- yə·p̄un·neh haq·qə·niz·zî ’at·tāh yā·ḏa‘·tā ’eṯ- had·dā·ḇār ’ă·šer- dib·ber Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh ’îš- hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ‘al ’ō·ḏō·w·ṯay wə·‘al ’ō·ḏō·w·ṯe·ḵā bə·qā·ḏêš bar·nê·a‘
verses.literal: Then the sons of Judah approached Joshua at Gilgal and Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite said . . . to him You know - what the LORD said to Moses the man of God at Kadesh-barnea about you and me
verses.literalPt: Então os filhos de Judá chegaram a Josué em Gilgal; e Calebe, filho de Jefoné o quenezeu, lhe disse: Tu sabes o que o SENHOR falou a Moisés, homem de Deus, em Cades-Barnéia por causa de mim e de ti.

verses.original: בֶּן־ אַרְבָּעִ֨ים שָׁנָ֜ה אָנֹכִ֗י בִּ֠שְׁלֹחַ מֹשֶׁ֨ה עֶֽבֶד־ יְהוָ֥ה אֹתִ֛י מִקָּדֵ֥שׁ בַּרְנֵ֖עַ לְרַגֵּ֣ל אֶת־ הָאָ֑רֶץ וָאָשֵׁ֤ב אֹתוֹ֙ דָּבָ֔ר כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר עִם־ לְבָבִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ben- ’ar·bā·‘îm šā·nāh ’ā·nō·ḵî biš·lō·aḥ mō·šeh ‘e·ḇeḏ- Yah·weh ’ō·ṯî miq·qā·ḏêš bar·nê·a‘ lə·rag·gêl ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ wā·’ā·šêḇ ’ō·ṯōw dā·ḇār ka·’ă·šer ‘im- lə·ḇā·ḇî
verses.literal: I was forty years old . . . when Moses the servant of the LORD sent me from Kadesh-barnea to spy out the land and I brought back to him an honest . . . . . . report
verses.literalPt: Quarenta anos tinha eu, quando Moisés, servo do SENHOR, me enviou de Cades-Barnéia a espiar a terra; e eu lhe trouxe resposta, como sentia no meu coração;

verses.original: וְאַחַי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָל֣וּ עִמִּ֔י הִמְסִ֖יו אֶת־ לֵ֣ב הָעָ֑ם וְאָנֹכִ֣י מִלֵּ֔אתִי אַחֲרֵ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’a·ḥay ’ă·šer ‘ā·lū ‘im·mî him·sîw ’eṯ- lêḇ hā·‘ām wə·’ā·nō·ḵî mil·lê·ṯî ’a·ḥă·rê Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hāy
verses.literal: Although my brothers who went with me made the hearts of the people melt with fear I remained loyal to the LORD my God
verses.literalPt: Mas meus irmãos, que subiram comigo, fizeram derreter o coração do povo; eu porém perseverei em seguir ao SENHOR meu Deus.

verses.original: וַיִּשָּׁבַ֣ע מֹשֶׁ֗ה בַּיּ֣וֹם הַהוּא֮ לֵאמֹר֒ אִם־ לֹ֗א הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר דָּרְכָ֤ה רַגְלְךָ֙ בָּ֔הּ לְךָ֨ תִֽהְיֶ֧ה לְנַחֲלָ֛ה וּלְבָנֶ֖יךָ עַד־ עוֹלָ֑ם כִּ֣י מִלֵּ֔אתָ אַחֲרֵ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·šā·ḇa‘ mō·šeh bay·yō·wm ha·hū lê·mōr ’im- lō hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer dā·rə·ḵāh raḡ·lə·ḵā bāh lə·ḵā ṯih·yeh lə·na·ḥă·lāh ū·lə·ḇā·ne·ḵā ‘aḏ- ‘ō·w·lām kî mil·lê·ṯā ’a·ḥă·rê Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hāy
verses.literal: On that day Moses swore to me saying Surely . . . the land on which you have set foot . . . will be an inheritance to you and your children forever . . . because you have wholly followed the LORD my God
verses.literalPt: Então Moisés naquele dia jurou, dizendo: Certamente a terra que pisou o teu pé será tua, e de teus filhos, em herança perpetuamente; pois perseveraste em seguir ao SENHOR meu Deus.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה הִנֵּה֩ הֶחֱיָ֨ה יְהוָ֣ה׀ אוֹתִי֮ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֵּר֒ זֶה֩ אַרְבָּעִ֨ים וְחָמֵ֜שׁ שָׁנָ֗ה מֵ֠אָז דִּבֶּ֨ר יְהוָ֜ה אֶת־ הַדָּבָ֤ר הַזֶּה֙ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ הָלַ֥ךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר וְעַתָּה֙ הִנֵּ֣ה אָנֹכִ֣י הַיּ֔וֹם בֶּן־ חָמֵ֥שׁ וּשְׁמוֹנִ֖ים שָׁנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh hin·nêh he·ḥĕ·yāh Yah·weh ’ō·w·ṯî ka·’ă·šer dib·bêr zeh ’ar·bā·‘îm wə·ḥā·mêš šā·nāh mê·’āz dib·ber Yah·weh ’eṯ- had·dā·ḇār haz·zeh ’el- mō·šeh ’ă·šer- hā·laḵ yiś·rā·’êl bam·miḏ·bār wə·‘at·tāh hin·nêh ’ā·nō·ḵî hay·yō·wm ben- ḥā·mêš ū·šə·mō·w·nîm šā·nāh
verses.literal: Now behold as the LORD promised He has kept me alive these forty-five . . . years since He spoke this word to Moses while Israel wandered in the wilderness So here I am today . . . eighty-five . . . years old . . .
verses.literalPt: E agora eis que o SENHOR me conservou em vida, como disse; quarenta e cinco anos são passados, desde que o SENHOR falou esta palavra a Moisés, andando Israel ainda no deserto; e agora eis que hoje tenho já oitenta e cinco anos;

verses.original: עוֹדֶ֨נִּי הַיּ֜וֹם חָזָ֗ק כַּֽאֲשֶׁר֙ בְּי֨וֹם שְׁלֹ֤חַ אוֹתִי֙ מֹשֶׁ֔ה כְּכֹ֥חִי אָ֖ז וּכְכֹ֣חִי עָ֑תָּה לַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה וְלָצֵ֥את וְלָבֽוֹא׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ō·w·ḏen·nî hay·yō·wm ḥā·zāq ka·’ă·šer bə·yō·wm šə·lō·aḥ ’ō·w·ṯî mō·šeh kə·ḵō·ḥî ’āz ū·ḵə·ḵō·ḥî ‘āt·tāh lam·mil·ḥā·māh wə·lā·ṣêṯ wə·lā·ḇō·w
verses.literal: still as strong today as I was the day Moses sent me out As my strength was then so it is now for war for going out and for coming in
verses.literalPt: E ainda hoje estou tão forte como no dia em que Moisés me enviou; qual era a minha força então, tal é agora a minha força, tanto para a guerra como para sair e entrar.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה תְּנָה־ לִּי֙ אֶת־ הָהָ֣ר הַזֶּ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא כִּ֣י אַתָּֽה־ שָׁמַעְתָּ֩ בַיּ֨וֹם הַה֜וּא כִּֽי־ עֲנָקִ֣ים שָׁ֗ם וְעָרִים֙ גְּדֹל֣וֹת בְּצֻר֔וֹת אוּלַ֨י יְהוָ֤ה אוֹתִי֙ וְה֣וֹרַשְׁתִּ֔ים כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh tə·nāh- lî ’eṯ- hā·hār haz·zeh ’ă·šer- dib·ber Yah·weh bay·yō·wm ha·hū kî ’at·tāh- šā·ma‘·tā ḇay·yō·wm ha·hū kî- ‘ă·nā·qîm šām wə·‘ā·rîm gə·ḏō·lō·wṯ bə·ṣu·rō·wṯ ’ū·lay Yah·weh ’ō·w·ṯî wə·hō·w·raš·tîm ka·’ă·šer dib·ber Yah·weh
verses.literal: Now therefore give me this hill country that the LORD promised me on that day for you yourself heard then . . . that the Anakim were there with great and fortified cities Perhaps with the LORD’s help I will drive them out as the LORD has spoken
verses.literalPt: Agora, pois, dá-me este monte de que o SENHOR falou aquele dia; pois naquele dia tu ouviste que estavam ali os anaquins, e grandes e fortes cidades. Porventura o SENHOR será comigo, para os expulsar, como o SENHOR disse.

verses.original: וַֽיְבָרְכֵ֖הוּ יְהוֹשֻׁ֑עַ וַיִּתֵּ֧ן אֶת־ חֶבְר֛וֹן לְכָלֵ֥ב בֶּן־ יְפֻנֶּ֖ה לְנַחֲלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḇā·rə·ḵê·hū yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ way·yit·tên ’eṯ- ḥeḇ·rō·wn lə·ḵā·lêḇ ben- yə·p̄un·neh lə·na·ḥă·lāh
verses.literal: Then Joshua blessed Caleb son of Jephunneh and gave him Hebron as his inheritance
verses.literalPt: E Josué o abençoou, e deu a Calebe, filho de Jefoné, a Hebrom em herança.

verses.original: עַל־ כֵּ֣ן הָיְתָֽה־ חֶ֠בְרוֹן לְכָלֵ֨ב בֶּן־ יְפֻנֶּ֤ה הַקְּנִזִּי֙ לְֽנַחֲלָ֔ה עַ֖ד הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה יַ֚עַן אֲשֶׁ֣ר מִלֵּ֔א אַחֲרֵ֕י יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- kên hā·yə·ṯāh- ḥeḇ·rō·wn lə·ḵā·lêḇ ben- yə·p̄un·neh haq·qə·niz·zî lə·na·ḥă·lāh ‘aḏ hay·yō·wm haz·zeh ya·‘an ’ă·šer mil·lê ’a·ḥă·rê Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Therefore . . . Hebron belongs to Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite as an inheritance to this day because he wholly followed the LORD the God of Israel
verses.literalPt: Portanto Hebrom ficou sendo herança de Calebe, filho de Jefoné o quenezeu, até ao dia de hoje, porquanto perseverara em seguir ao SENHOR Deus de Israel.

verses.original: וְשֵׁ֨ם חֶבְר֤וֹן לְפָנִים֙ קִרְיַ֣ת אַרְבַּ֔ע הָאָדָ֧ם הַגָּד֛וֹל בָּעֲנָקִ֖ים ה֑וּא וְהָאָ֥רֶץ שָׁקְטָ֖ה מִמִּלְחָמָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·šêm ḥeḇ·rō·wn lə·p̄ā·nîm qir·yaṯ ’ar·ba‘ hā·’ā·ḏām hag·gā·ḏō·wl bā·‘ă·nā·qîm hū wə·hā·’ā·reṣ šā·qə·ṭāh mim·mil·ḥā·māh
verses.literal: Hebron used to be called Kiriath-arba after Arba the greatest man among the Anakim Then the land had rest from war
verses.literalPt: E antes o nome de Hebrom era Quiriate-Arba, porque Arba foi o maior homem entre os anaquins. E a terra repousou da guerra.
